query:
UPDATE email_outbox
            SET status = $4::SMALLINT,
                attempts = $5,
                next_attempt_at = CASE
                    WHEN $4::SMALLINT = $8::SMALLINT THEN NOW() + make_interval(secs => $6::DOUBLE PRECISION)
                    ELSE next_attempt_at
                END,
                locked_by = NULL,
                locked_at = NULL,
                last_error = $7
            WHERE id = $1
              AND locked_by = $2
              AND lock_version = $3
              AND status = $9::SMALLINT
            RETURNING status AS "status!"
